epics.title: Password Reset
epics.description: Enable users to reset their password.

user_stories.title: Password Reset
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to reset my password, so that I can regain access to my account.

acceptance_criteria.given: User has forgotten their password and needs to regain access to their account
acceptance_criteria.then: The system allows the user to set a new password and the user can subsequently log in with the new password

test_cases.title: Password reset allows setting new password and subsequent login
test_cases.precondition: User has forgotten their password and needs to regain access to their account
steps: System prompts user to set a new password
User provides a new password and confirms it
User attempts to log in using the newly set password
test_cases.expected_result: System accepts the new password, updates the account, and the user successfully logs in with the new password
